title: GTA VI Trophy Guide & Tracker
note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation list. Guide text is written for this app; where a trigger is still being confirmed by players, the guide says so instead of inventing a method.

roadmap.title: Play the story
roadmap.text: Chapters 1 to 4 and the final mission. Twelve story trophies pop just by finishing the story, including the chapter trophies and the gold for the final mission. Do the Chapter 1 meditation spot for Positive Mental Attitude before Chapter 1 ends — it is the one trophy the published guides flag as possibly missable. Do not use cheats: they disable trophies and saving (GTABase).

roadmap.title: Strangers & Freaks
roadmap.text: Follow the stranger mission strands — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret — to their final missions. Eight completed strands earn the silver; there are more strands than eight, so you do not need every one. Stranger missions are not part of 100% completion (GTABase).

roadmap.title: Activities and challenges
roadmap.text: The grind stage: 250 stunts, gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, drone races at all 14 locations, 20 different races won, a fishing challenge against Cal, one arcade game, all 18 meditation spots, bowling, and 50 of the 80 challenges. The Shootist is one of the two trophies the guides call hardest.

roadmap.title: Crime spree with your partner
roadmap.text: The partner robberies: 3 shops back-to-back, a jewelry store unseen, an armored truck, 5 bank vaults, one illegal operation per gang, plus the 4-star escape, the Combat Focus multi-kill and the VCIA departure. Plan escape routes before you go in.

roadmap.title: Collect and explore
roadmap.text: Sweep Leonida: 52 areas explored, 100 vehicles discovered, 100 WAiNK tags, 3 card sets, all 8 garages bought, 10 vehicles registered, $250,000 laundered and $100,000 spent. Do these alongside the other stages — exploration feeds three trophies at once.

roadmap.title: 100% completion, then platinum
roadmap.text: Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work through what is left: story, robberies, bank vaults, gang operations, shooting ranges, drone races, card decks, underwater discoveries and 70 of the 80 challenges (GTABase). Around 100 hours of the roughly 200-hour platinum sits here. When A Long Road pops, the platinum follows at once.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are done — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work through the roadmap in order and this is the last trophy you earn. All 55 trophies are offline and single-player, and one playthrough is enough (KeenGamer, GTABase).

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Unmissable. Complete the opening mission, Gone Fishing, and the trophy pops at the end of it. It is the first story trophy, so just play the opening as directed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Unmissable. Awarded for finishing Chapter 1 — keep playing the story missions in order and it pops at the chapter's end. Before the chapter closes, do the Chapter 1 meditation spot for Positive Mental Attitude (see that trophy): it is the one trophy the published guides flag as possibly missable.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Unmissable. Finish Chapter 2. No side content is needed for it — just keep following the story.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Unmissable. Finish Chapter 3. It pops at the end of the chapter like the other chapter trophies.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Unmissable. Finish Chapter 4, the last chapter trophy before the finale.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Unmissable. Complete the final mission of the story. It is the only hidden gold trophy, so its name stays masked while spoiler mode is on.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Complete the mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the story; it pops on completion.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Complete the mission The Cartel Heist.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Complete the mission Child's Play.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Complete the mission Headliners.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Complete the mission VCIA Takedown.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Complete Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The long one. Attain 100% completion — the game tracks it under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion (KeenGamer). That checklist covers the story, robberies, bank vaults, gang operations, shooting ranges, drone races, Bret's card decks, underwater discoveries and 70 of the 80 challenges (GTABase). Expect around 100 hours of the roughly 200-hour platinum on this checklist alone (GTABase). Save it for last, after the story and the side strands.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts across Leonida. Stunts are the game's jumps, near-misses and airtime moments — they accumulate as you drive and ride aggressively, and the count is tracked in your stats. A steady way to grind them is to chain jumps and near-misses on the highways. The 250 total is confirmed by KeenGamer and GTABase, but exactly which moves count as a stunt is still being mapped by players, so check your stats counter as you go.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. There are nine activity types (KeenGamer) — the ones named by other trophies cover most of them: fishing, racing, the shooting range, drone races, arcade games, bowling and meditation. Your stats screen shows which types you have tried, so work through the list and fill the gaps.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit the shooting ranges around Leonida and work through every challenge; gold medals need fast, accurate shooting, so learn each range's weapon and target layout before going for gold. This is one of the two trophies the published roadmaps call hardest, alongside A Long Road (GamesFuze).

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — 14 locations in total. Drone races are a repeatable activity; winning at each of the 14 spots is what counts, so keep a checklist of the locations you have already won at.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Races count per event, so winning the same race twice does not help — you need 20 distinct race events won. Street, off-road and water races all count toward the total as long as each event is a different one.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are an activity you can start at fishing spots; Cal is the rival angler. Out-fish him in a head-to-head challenge — bigger and rarer catches win the round.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade machine — arcades are marked around Leonida — and play a full game through to its end. Any arcade game counts.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy is one of the Strangers & Freaks contacts; follow his mission strand to its last mission. Stranger strands unlock as you explore Leonida and are not part of 100% completion (GTABase), so do them when they appear.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Same pattern as Andy's strand — follow Kenton's missions to the end.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Follow Billy's strand to its final mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. There are more than eight strands available — the character finals (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret) are six of them — so you do not need every strand in the game, just eight completed ones.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Follow Randy's strand to its end.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Follow Tyrone's strand to its end.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: Do the Chapter 1 meditation before the chapter ends.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots. This is the one trophy the published guides flag as possibly missable (GTABase, PowerPyx via GTASpotter, KeenGamer): one meditation spot is in Chapter 1, with Lucia, and may not be available later. Do every meditation spot as soon as you find it, and do not leave Chapter 1 without meditating at Lucia's balcony spot (GTABase). After the story, sweep the remaining spots in free roam.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand involves hunting; a specific unique animal is the target — follow Bret's missions and the hunt it sets up.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida — Bret's Target Decks feed into this, per GTABase's 100% notes. Collect every card in three full sets; the card menu shows which sets you have finished.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK is the in-game tagging activity — use it at 100 different spots around Leonida. Your stats track the count; spread it across the map as you explore so it finishes alongside The Goodtime State.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. The game has 80 challenges in eight groups of ten (GTASpotter, citing PowerPyx), so you need 50 of the 80 — pick the easiest groups first and let the rest come while you work on 100% completion, which itself needs 70 of the 80 (GTABase).

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear — use back roads, water or the countryside to lose the search.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Rob one shop, then immediately hit two more while the wanted level from the first is still active — do not let it clear between robberies, and do not get caught. Plan a route with three close shops first.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or ride 100 different vehicle models — 'discover' means a model you have not used before, so try everything: cars, bikes, boats and aircraft. The count is tracked in your stats.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-motion aiming mode — activate it during a firefight with at least five enemies in view and drop all five before it ends. Pick a busy shootout rather than a quiet one.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. VCIA is the Vice City airport — the natural reading is to leave it by an unscheduled route, not through the normal exit: steal a plane or drive off the airfield. The exact trigger is still being confirmed by players, so treat this as the working method and check the cited guides for updates.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Rhinos are the game's tanks, so the trophy involves the Rhino: get into a Rhino tank — they appear at high wanted levels and military spots — and use it. The exact trigger is still being confirmed by players; try driving a Rhino and causing mayhem with it, and check the cited guides as the community confirms the method.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Scope the store, enter quietly and avoid the cameras and staff sightlines — a stealthy approach, not a smash-and-grab. If you are spotted, leave and try again.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Bank vaults are the big heists — hit five of them and get away clean each time. Plan your escape route before you go in; vaults are also part of the 100% checklist (GTABase).

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida — intercept one, crack it open and lose the wanted level.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — 52 areas. The map is split into 52 named areas; visit every one. Pair it with WAiNK It and vehicle discovery so the exploration does triple duty.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — 9 gangs. Find one illegal operation per gang and rob it. Gang operations are also part of the 100% checklist (GTABase).

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view — a quiet moment trophy.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a vehicle through a showroom's glass front and out the other side — a deliberate, over-the-top exit, GTA-style.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go bowling at that alley and finish a game — follow-through suggests completing the game, not just throwing a ball.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The description is deliberately vague — it is tied to a partner moment, and the exact trigger is still being confirmed by players. The published guides list it among the hidden trophies whose solutions are not yet verified (KeenGamer). Do not trust unverified methods; check the cited guides as the community confirms it.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). PlayStation tracks a count toward 500 for this one, so it is about making choices across the game — it should come naturally over a full playthrough, since the count suggests repeated decisions rather than one big choice. The exact counting is still being confirmed.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The description suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt — the community has not confirmed a specific trigger yet. Try retrying a failed activity or challenge; if it does not pop, wait for the guides to confirm it rather than chasing guesses.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? A hidden trophy for witnessing something strange — likely a rare random event or easter egg in Leonida. No verified trigger is published yet; the published guides mark hidden-trophy solutions as still being confirmed (KeenGamer). Keep playing and exploring; do not chase unverified methods.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. While driving, use a melee attack to knock someone down — a drive-by with a melee weapon rather than a gun. Find a quiet stretch, line up a pedestrian and swing as you pass.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies — launder them through your contacts and the total adds up; $250,000 is the target. Do it steadily as you rob, so the money is clean by the time you finish the crime trophies.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, food, weapons and upgrades — every shop purchase counts toward the total, and $100,000 goes fast once you start buying gear.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 garages. Buy every garage property on the map; garages also give you somewhere to store the vehicles you register for On the Spot.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Use the Scooter Bros app to register vehicles you own or find — 10 registrations is the target.
